title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 101 East Market Street in Long Beach, California, as the "Juanita Millender-McDonald Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 101 East Market Street in Long Beach, California, as the "Juanita Millender-McDonald Post Office."

summary.headline: Names a Long Beach, California Postal Service building after the late Congresswoman Juanita Millender-McDonald.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 101 East Market Street in Long Beach, California, as the "Juanita Millender-McDonald Post Office." It is a symbolic honor and does not change how the post office operates or who it serves.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 18, 2014.
